Falcon generates IncidentSummaryEvent for every incident and each time an adversary
to new hosts as part of an incident. Lateral movement is when an adversary is
moving through multiple systems to reach their goal. IncidentSummaryEvent generates only when an incident’s score reaches certain thresholds, when the incident
is closed, and each time an adversary
to a new host as part of an incident.
Each lateral movement event adds a new host to the array in IncidentSummaryEvent—to a maximum of 15 hosts. Because of this, you can expect more incident
summary events whenever lateral movement occurs.
